items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Test matches every AC in the iterate spec verbatim; independently re-verified by spec-reviewer (PASS, 0 findings) after 3 earlier divergences were fixed.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Test-only file, no production error-handling paths added; the test calls real cmd_* functions and asserts their own return-code contracts.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, no secrets; hashlib.sha256 is used only to compare local diff bytes, never for anything security-sensitive.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Every assertion checks a real production return code, on-disk state, or independently recomputed hash -- never a bare 'it did not crash'.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Single test, no list endpoints or DB loops; git subprocess calls are the intended real I/O this integration test exists to exercise.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: File is 234 lines (under the 300 limit) after trimming comment verbosity post-fix; single pytest root (shared/tests), matches test_wave_launch_failure_and_reconcile.py conventions.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No new serialized format; the test drives loop_state.json exclusively through existing production cmd_* functions, never hand-writing/parsing a new on-disk shape.
